title: [Day 02] Session format and event types
text:
Part 4 of 5 is in. `createEvent(type, data, clock)` fills `seq` and `timestamp`. `isEventOfType` narrows on the kind. `FORMAT_VERSION` is `1`, and `version()` returns it.

`seq` starts at 1 and increases per clock instance, including when 1000 events share one millisecond. A second clock starts again at 1. The counter is a `WeakMap` on the factory, so a test clock is only `{ now: () => 0 }`. That choice is ADR 0008.

Checks on `5dbd132`: `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`, and `pnpm build` all passed. Part 5 is still open, so this PR stays a draft.
